details:
This update for php8 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-15353: SOAP information disclosure through malformed array dimensions (bsc#1290681).
- CVE-2026-115560: possible RCE via session upload progress() (bsc#1289303).
- CVE-2026-126714: Partially overwritten session files can lead to remote code execution (bsc#1290690).
- CVE-2026-127960: Denial of service through folded HTTP response headers (bsc#1290689).
- CVE-2026-128064: Mixed-case HTTPS and FTPS URLs can expose data in plaintext (bsc#1290688).
- CVE-2026-128090: PHAR OpenSSL signature bypass via algorithm downgrade (bsc#1290684).
- CVE-2026-129289: PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body (bsc#1290687).
- CVE-2026-129291: PHP-FPM epoll use-after-free can lead to local privilege escalation (bsc#1290692).
- CVE-2026-129292: PHP-FPM status endpoint XSS via unescaped user and script fields (bsc#1290685).
- CVE-2026-129481: Use-after-free after interrupted session shutdown (bsc#1290693).
- CVE-2026-129496: Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote code execution (bsc#1290686).
- CVE-2026-129501: Double free during DOM XML serialization (bsc#1290691).
- CVE-2026-129506: SOAP use-after-free when processing DTD entity references (bsc#1290683).
- CVE-2026-129538: PHP-CGI out-of-bounds read and write during PATH_INFO correction (bsc#1290682).

Changes for php8:

Update to version 8.4.28:

 Core:
 . Fixed bug GH-24184 (System ID not being reinitialized after an Apache
 graceful restart, potentially causing incompatible OPcache file cache
 entries to be reused). (Levi Morrison)
 . Fixed memory leak when an exception already contains the pending exception
 in its previous chain. (Edmond)
 . Fixed bug GH-23979 (Nullsafe operator must not flush delayed oplines of an
 enclosing function). (ndossche)
 . Fixed memory manager keeping a block reallocated to exactly the size of
 the next smaller bin in its larger bin, which efree_size() then freed
 into the wrong one. (Marc Bennewitz)
 . Fixed bug GH-24218 (Invalid opcode for count() of a literal array
 without SCCP). (lazerg)
 . Fix throwing behaviour with recursive arrays in VM. (ndossche)
 . Fixed skipped catch block when switching fibers during exception unwinding
 (Nicolas Grekas)
 . Fix escape analysis for objects implementing ArrayAccess. (ndossche, Arnaud)
 . Fix UAF for resolved callable zval. (EdmondDantes)
 . Fix memory leak for nested HTTP calls. (EdmondDantes)
 . Fixed pthread attribute leak in zend_call_stack_get_netbsd_pthread().
 (David Carlier)
 . Fixed bug GH-24321 (ZTS: global_map_ptr_last survives zend_shutdown(),
 so an in-process engine restart keeps growing the map_ptr table).
 . Fix function and constant imports in compile_to_ast and add support
 for grouping. (Klaas Skelte van der Werf)
 . Fixed bug GH-24265 (Unwind/GracefulExit discarded in
 zend_fiber_execute()). (David Carlier)
 . Fixed bug GH-24668 (zend_set_local_var() leaks the previous value of an
 existing CV). (yasu20200121web-prog, lazerg)
 . Fixed unmapping of an unrelated range when the aligned chunk mmap fails
 (Marti2203).
 . Fixed bug GH-24989 (Use-after-free in GC when an exception is thrown).
 . Fixed bug GH-24534 (Segfault in zend_try_early_bind when a parent class
 autoloads its cached child during linking). (David Carlier)
 . Fixed AST printing dropping final on class constants and properties, and
 abstract on properties. (Jorg Sowa)
 . Fixed AST export of readonly anonymous classes dropping the readonly
 modifier. (Jorg Sowa)
 . Fixed memory leak of a duplicate named argument in new in initializer.
 (Jorg Sowa)
 . Fixed bug GH-25061 ($x = $x - 1 on null is optimized to PRE_DEC).
 (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 . Fixed bug GH-24480 (Finally block running a second time when a VM interrupt
 throws as the finally block returns to a "return" in its try block).
 (C. Scott Ananian)
 CLI:
 . Fixed bug GH-24697 (PHP_HTTP_PARSER_STRICT build option doesn't work).
 (ndossche, devnexen)
 . Fixed bug GH-9670 (List -C and -q in the CLI help). (Juan Versolato Lopes)
 . Fixed crash and leak in the built-in server on repeated request headers.
 COM:
 . Fixed bug GH-25008 (com_event_sink() and com_print_typeinfo() crash
 resolving an event source with no loaded typelib). (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 Curl:
 . Fix use-after-free of CURLOPT_STDERR stream on cloned curl handle.
 (lacatoire)
 . Fix UAF on clone due to callback data pointer mismatch. (ndossche)
 Date:
 . Fixed bug GH-20503 (Assertion failure with ext/date DateInterval property
 hash construction). (heathdutton)
 . Fixed bug GH-24350 (MINIT reads a stale external tz database after an
 in-process module restart). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 DBA:
 . Fixed bug GH-24641 (ndbm backend never checks dbm_open() return value,
 NULL deref on first use after a failed open). (Girgias)
 DOM:
 . Fixed a use-after-free when reflected attribute setters replace an
 attribute whose child still has a live wrapper. (Jakub Zelenka)
 . Fixed bug GH-23352 (UAF reading an attribute value node retained across
 DOMDocument::adoptNode()). (David Carlier)
 . Fixed bug GH-24260 (querySelectorAll() returns duplicate elements for
 selector lists). (fivefilters)
 . Fixed bug GH-23334 (Use-after-free in php_dom_free_templated_content()).
 (David Carlier, ndossche)
 . Fixed bug GH-22077 (UAF in custom XPath function). (Joe Afflerbach)
 . Fixed bug GH-22554 (use-after-free with XPath callback returning a node
 from a foreign document). (David Carlier)
 . Fixed DOMXPath crash wrapping a foreign node after a nodeset callback.
 (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 . Fix error paths in dom_xml_serializing_a_document_node(). (ndossche)
 . Fixed use-after-free on namespace axis results with a foreign-document
 XPath callback node. (David Carlier)
 FFI:
 . Fixed bug GH-24582 (Memory leaks in ext/ffi parser when finalize_type()
 bails out). (matyapiro31, David Carlier)
 FPM:
 . Fixed bug GH-24229 (fcgi_close() passes shutdown() a literal 1, which is
 SHUT_RD in WASI). (Ryosuke Ishibashi)
 . Fixed crash and stack memory disclosure in the worker output logging with
 a pool name longer than the message prefix buffer or log_limit.
 (Martin Mirchev)
 . Fixed memory leaks of the _GET string on the status page error and HEAD
 request paths. (Marcel Hernandez)
 . Fixed use-after-free of the scoreboard copy when logging invalid status
 values. (Marcel Hernandez)
 . Fixed null pointer dereference in fpm_get_status() when the scoreboard
 copy fails. (Marcel Hernandez)
 Fileinfo:
 . Fixed bug GH-24289 (finfo::file() reports the wrong argument number for
 an invalid $filename). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 FTP:
 . Fix double free in ext/ftp data_accept() on accept failure. (alepacheco)
 GD:
 . Fixed imagetruecolortopalette() error message. (Marc Bennewitz)
 Hash:
 . Fix GOST and Snefru digests of 512 MiB or more. (Martin Mirchev)
 Intl:
 . Fixed IntlDateFormatter parse functions truncating an $offset below
 INT_MIN. (Marc Bennewitz)
 JSON:
 . Fixed json_encode() leaving the recursion guard set on objects with hooked
 properties after running out of memory while escaping a property name.
 (adapik)
 . Fixed json_encode() silently narrowing $depth values outside the int range,
 which wrapped to an unrelated depth. (cuishuang)
 . Fixed json_encode() continuing to encode after an array or object key
 failed to encode. (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 LDAP:
 . Fix crash in ldap_exop_sync() when $response_data is omitted. (lacatoire)
 MBString:
 . Fixed bug GH-23958 (truncated encoding names resolving to full names). (Kamil Tekiela)
 . Fixed out-of-bounds read in php_mb_rfc1867_getword() on a multibyte lead
 byte at the end of a multipart field name. (Jorg Sowa)
 . Fixed negative mbstring.regex_stack_limit and mbstring.regex_retry_limit
 on 32bit platforms. (Marc Bennewitz)
 MySQLnd:
 . Fixed bug GH-24293 (Segfault on connect with an empty password to a
 MariaDB PAM account). (lazerg)
 . Fixed bug GH-24609 (OK packets without an info message rejected on x32
 builds). (lazerg)
 ODBC:
 . Fixed bug GH-24736 (php_odbc_connstr_is_quoted() treats a value with no
 closing brace as quoted). (lazerg)
 . Fixed bug GH-25036 (odbc_prepare() corrupts the heap when the driver
 cannot describe a parameter). (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 Opcache:
 . Fixed bug GH-24397 (Assertion failure when dumping JIT IR).
 . Fixed tracing JIT returning a wrapped integer instead of a float on
 integer overflow after an integer was compared with a float or
 numeric-string literal. (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 . Fixed bug GH-20890 (Segfault in zval_undefined_cv with non-simple property
 hook with minimal tracing JIT). (ndossche)
 . Fixed bug GH-17626 (JIT corrupts an opline handler when blacklisting a
 root trace at the opcache.jit_max_root_traces limit, causing spurious
 "Too few arguments" errors and crashes). (RV7PR)
 . Fix type inference of ADD_ARRAY_UNPACK with integer keys. (ndossche)
 . Fix too wide type inference for ASSIGN_DIM_OP. (ndossche)
 . Fix OSS-Fuzz #568005340 (FETCH_DIM_FUNC_ARG partial conversion). (ndossche)
 . Fixed bug GH-24218 (Invalid opcode for count() of a literal array when
 SCCP is disabled). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 . Fixed bug GH-24337 (JIT: segfault when decrementing a non-numeric string
 property). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 . Fix SIGFPE on LONG_MIN % -1 with a constant divisor. (waroad)
 . Fixed bug GH-24388 (Tracing JIT: segfault when a trace runs out of side
 exits). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 . Fixed bug GH-24391 (JIT switch on constant null takes default instead of
 case 0). (ndossche)
 . Fixed bug GH-24206 (Tracing JIT loses loop-carried CV when its loop PHI
 is reloaded from memory). (ndossche)
 . Fixed bug GH-24386 (JIT: register operand must be loaded before the typed
 reference check). (ndossche)
 . Fixed bug GH-24437 (JIT: Fix OP_DATA read from an unwritten slot in
 zend_jit_assign_dim_op()). (waroad)
 . Fixed bug GH-24398 (JIT: minimal JIT segfault when a hooked property is
 passed to a run-time-resolved function). (waroad)
 . Fixed bug GH-24389 (Tracing JIT: type guard on entry of an inlined call
 exits with an uninitialized opline). (waroad)
 . Fixed use-after-free in JIT ASSIGN_DIM_OP when concatenating into an
 empty array element. (jorgsowa)
 . Fixed bug GH-24396 (Assertion failure in zend_jit_def_reg() "reg forwarding"
 with chained Pi nodes). (ndossche)
 . Fixed JIT treating an array as packed after a string key write turned it
 into a hash. (jorgsowa)
 . Fixed bug GH-24436 (Tracing JIT: keep the SEND_VAL type guard after
 assigning to a reference). (waroad)
 . Fixed bug GH-17733 (System entropy does not take into account function
 order, resulting in wrong functions possibly called
 in different configurations). (ndossche)
 . Fixed bug GH-24438 (Preserve indirect types in JIT side traces). (aasul)
 . Fixed bug GH-24577 (CE-cache flag on interned class name visible before
 map_ptr offset). (prateekbhujel)
 . Fixed tracing JIT losing register-allocated CVs when an interrupt is
 handled at the end of a loop trace. (Levi Morrison)
 . Fixed bug GH-24675 (function with >~1.7 MB of machine code corrupts JIT
 buffer accounting). (ndossche)
 . Call orig_post_shutdown_cb(). (ndossche)
 . Fixed JIT segfault on switch over a string reference holding a
 non-string value. (jorgsowa)
 . Fixed AArch64 JIT encoding of invalid logical immediates. (jorgsowa)
 . Fixed unsound shift_left_overflows range when shift wraps. (mkrishna793)
 . Fix block pass dropping ZEND_FAST_CALL OP2 definition. (Mrmaxmeier)
 . Fixed bug GH-23626 (orphaned temporaries cause leaks and assertions).
 (ndossche, khaledalam)
 . Fix preloaded functions JIT-compiled on load being overwritten
 after restart. (Pavel Gushcha)
 . Fix opcache.interned_strings_buffer being 0 in threads started later (ZTS).
 (Pavel Gushcha)
 . Fixed potential infinite recursion/hang (HYBRID/TAILCALL respectively)
 when zend_interrupt_function resets EG(vm_interrupt). (Levi Morrison)
 . Fixed preloaded functions not JIT-compiled again after OPcache restart.
 . Fixed bug GH-24988 (Incorrect opcode range check causes bugs with exceptions in
 function JIT). (ndossche, Jorg Sowa)
 . Fix opcache phar check. (ndossche)
 OpenSSL:
 . Fixed build and test compatibility with OpenSSL 4.0 and 4.1.
 (Sam James, Weilin Du, Shivam Mathur)
 . Fixed bug GH-24784 (openssl_pkcs7_read() and openssl_cms_read() overwrite
 certificates with CRLs). (Alexander Danilov)
 PDO:
 . Fixed invalid ATTR_ORACLE_NULLS values being accepted and truncated.
 . Fixed a duplicate warning when ATTR_STATEMENT_CLASS is rejected on a
 persistent connection. (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 PDO_Firebird:
 . Fixed bug GH-25006 (getColumnMeta() reads out of bounds for an
 out-of-range column index). (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 PDO_PGSQL:
 . Fixed a use-after-free when a persistent connection receives a notice
 after the request that called Pdo\Pgsql::setNoticeCallback() has ended.
 PDO_SQLite:
 . Fixed bug GH-24990 (Statement unusable after a failed execute()). (lazerg)
 . Fixed bug GH-25021 (SQLite createFunction corrupts large integers).
 (mvorisek)
 Phar:
 . Fixed bug GH-25093 (Phar::webPhar() redirect reads past the request URI).
 (lazerg)
 . Fixed bug GH-25089 (Heap buffer over-read via crafted alias size in
 zip-based phar). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 . Fixed bug GH-8469 (Phar::decompressFiles() and Phar::compressFiles() retain
 compressed contents after changing compression). (Raphael Paez)
 . Fixed bug GH-24740 (Oversized tar metadata exhausts the memory limit).
 . Fixed bug GH-25090 (UAF in phar rename() of an entry with metadata).
 . Fixed bug GH-25091 (UAF in phar rename() when source and destination
 are equal). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 . Fixed bug GH-25092 (Double free in Phar::copy() on link and
 mounted entries). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 . Fixed bug GH-24531 (Crash when modifying a zip-based phar whose file was
 renamed). (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 Phpdbg:
 . Fix wrong command names. (ndossche, Weilin Du)
 . Fixed bug GH-22480 (Use-after-free when re-watching an already-watched
 variable). (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 . Fixed over-read when watching a packed array element. (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 . Fixed double free of watch element chains. (Arnaud)
 Readline:
 . Fixed a crash in readline_info() when completion_append_character
 contains a non-ASCII byte. (Weilin Du)
 SAPI:
 . Fixed infinite loop in sapi_header_op() for headers of 4 GiB or more.
 SOAP:
 . Fixed use of uninitialized func in do_request() on OOM bailout.
 Session:
 . Validate whole session ID instead of stopping at the first NUL byte.
 (Sjoerd Langkemper)
 SimpleXML:
 . Fixed bug GH-24488 (GC double-frees the SimpleXMLElement properties
 table). (evankford)
 SPL:
 . Fixed bug GH-24264 (Unwind/GracefulExit discarded in spl_iterators.c).
 Sockets:
 . Fixed bug GH-24748 (socket_set_option() crashes with declared object
 properties). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
 Standard:
 . Fixed memory leaks in checkdnsrr() and dns_check_record() on Windows.
 . Fixed __unserialize() and __wakeup() being called for objects with a missing
 closing brace. (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 . Fixed bug GH-24308 (Request shutdown calls closelog() even when syslog
 was not opened by PHP). (lazerg)
 . Fixed bug GH-24399 (usleep() and time_nanosleep() ignore queued APCs on
 Windows). (Nicolas Grekas)
 . Fixed chown() and lchown() failing to resolve user names in ZTS builds
 when getpwnam_r() needs a larger buffer. (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 . Fixed password_get_info() and password_needs_rehash() accepting malformed
 bcrypt costs. (Ilia Alshanetsky)
 . Fixed proc_open() null descriptor not being inheritable on Windows.
 . Don't share the unserialize() context with enum autoloaders.
 . Fixed bug GH-24373 (serialize() called from a destructor during var_hash
 destruction reuses the outer var_hash). (David Carlier)
 . Fixed bug GH-24552 (Case-insensitive substr_compare(), ksort() and
 krsort() are still locale-dependent). (Lazizbek Ergashev, Jon Surrell)
 . Fixed bug GH-24605 (var_export() crashes on deeply nested arrays and
 objects). (Labish Bardiya)
 . Fix use-after-free in Randomizer::shuffleArray() when the engine throws.
 (Marti2203)
 Streams:
 . Fixed bug GH-24508 (HTTP wrapper leaks the dechunk filter when header
 parsing fails after Transfer-Encoding). (bercedev)
 . Fixed bug GH-24509 (HTTP wrapper leaks Location buffer on empty
 Location header). (bercedev)
 . Fix out-of-bounds reads parsing ftp:// wrapper server replies.
 (Alejandro Pacheco)
 Tidy:
 . Fixed tidy_repair_string(), tidy_repair_file(), tidy::repairString() and
 tidy::repairFile() rejecting null for $encoding. (lacatoire)
 Windows:
 . Fixed sapi_windows_cp_set() and sapi_windows_cp_conv() accepting a negative
 codepage on 32bit platforms. (Marc Bennewitz)
 . Fixed bug GH-25009 (GetConsoleTitleW() buffer size passed in bytes).
 Zip:
 . Reject broken libzip versions 1.3.1, 1.7.0 and 1.12.0 during Windows
 configuration. (Weilin Du)
 . Excluded libzip 1.12.0 due to a regression preventing additions and
 replacements in torrentzip archives. (Weilin Du)
 . Fixed use-after-free when re-entering ZipArchive during destruction or
 a close warning, and rejected opening streams while closing. (jvoisin)
 . Fixed a use-after-free when a ZipArchive method that modifies the archive
 is called from a progress or cancel callback during close().
 Zlib:
 . Fixed use-after-free when an error handler removes a failing zlib.inflate
 filter (GH-24176). (Edmond)
 . Fixed bug GH-24533 (zlib.lib could not be found because zlib 1.3.2
 CMake build does not emit it). (Lazizbek Ergashev)
